static_traits.name: Chen Haoran
static_traits.family_status: Living with partner, with two Chihuahuas
static_traits.social_status: 有朋友与家人可倾诉,但尚not yet就此事与任何人沟通;与Female友关系因not安而受到影响
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness;without既往类似心理问题或治疗史
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰,逻辑性较强,配合度高,能进行自我Reflection,语气平和

basic_info.main_problem: 我一直对自己收集贝壳的爱好感到Anxiety和not自信,因为我认为Female友觉得这很奇怪.几个月前注意到Female友的表情后开始紧张,尤其当我把她的表情解读为not赞同时,压力上升;目前发展到在谈及爱好时会感到not安,not敢与她或他人分享.
basic_info.core_demands: 我意识到Anxiety和not自信正在影响我的亲密关系并造成痛苦,因此寻求心理咨询以缓解困扰,改善关系.

special_situations.event: 向Female友展示贝壳收藏时,注意到她困惑或not感兴趣的表情
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果对方露出困惑或not感兴趣,就代表她negate我和我的爱好
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 避免与Female友谈论收藏,隐藏爱好以减少被negate的风险
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 她觉得I am strange,她not认可我

special_situations.event: When the topic of 'interests and hobbies' comes up in daily conversation
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我提到收集贝壳,do not人都会觉得我怪异并看轻我
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 在Social situations回避分享兴趣,Displacement话题
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 大家都会觉得我很怪,最好not要说

special_situations.event: 回想Female友曾出现的单次困惑/not感兴趣表情
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 负面线索比正面证据更可信;一旦出现not赞同,就说明整体被negate
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Ignores positive evidence in relationships, focusing only on negative cues
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 她大概整体上都not喜欢我的这一面

special_situations.event: 考虑是否与Female友直接沟通关于爱好与感受
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果把这件事挑明,她会当场deny我,看轻我,关系会恶化
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids starting conversations to protect relationships and self-esteem, continuing to stay silent

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be accepted and recognized by the partner as she is, able to share real interests freely
core_conflict.fear: 害怕因'与众not同'而被negate,被看轻,进而被疏远或抛弃
defense_goal: Reduces the possibility of being judged and humiliated through hiding and avoidance
以Rationalization的方式压低羞耻与Anxiety,维持自尊与关系的表面和谐

object_relations.self_representation: A fragile self, easily judged, that needs to hide real interests
object_relations.object_representation: 挑剔,可能negate或羞辱自己的重要他者(如Female友)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当咨询师建议与Female友直接沟通或邀请其表达更真实的感受时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: without意识地Anticipation对方会像重要他人一样negate自己(移情:将内在的negate期待投向当下关系)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 以分析和Interpretation为主,强调'现在not方便/not是合适时机'等理由,语气平和但回避直接表达Anxiety与羞耻.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当看到对方(尤其是Female友)露出困惑或not感兴趣的表情时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将自身的not安与羞耻感归因于对方'觉得我怪异'(移情/Projection)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use猜测他人想法的表述(如'她肯定觉得我怪'),减少自我感受表露,回避进一步求证.

manifestations: 害怕暴露真实兴趣后被negate,选择隐藏自我
将他人的表情解读为negate,感到与人疏离
not愿与伴侣或他人讨论真实担忧,回避直接接触

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'.
manifestations: 根据Female友的表情推测对方'觉得I am strange',not yet直接核实
In conversation, replaces expression of one's own experience with others' possible evaluations

contact_model.definition: The individual has maladaptive self-Reflection and excessive self-limitation, being overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Overly concerned with others' evaluations, worrying about being looked down on and avoiding sharing interests
在谈及爱好时小心翼翼,倾向于Repression真实偏好

positive_force: Shares multiple positive interests with the partner (yoga, outdoor activities), and the relationship has a positive foundation
Has a social support network of friends and family
Proactively seeks help, positive attitude; willing to try cognitive restructuring and self-affirmation
Able to describe automatic thoughts and emotional experiences, with a certain degree of self-awareness
negative_force: Highly sensitive to others' evaluations, overly dependent on external validation
Cognitive biases such as mind reading, overgeneralization, and mental filtering are prominent
回避直接沟通以短期减轻Anxiety,形成维持因素
Sleep and appetite disturbed,降低情绪复原力与专注力
自我标签化(将'与众not同'等同于'怪异')

antecedent: 向Female友展示收藏时看到其困惑或not感兴趣的表情
When the topic of 'interests / hobbies' comes up in conversation
在Work授课时想到伴侣可能not认可该爱好
target_behavior.core_reason: 将对方表情Interpretation为negate,自我贴上'很奇怪'的标签,伴随读心术与灾难化推理,trigger对Being rejected与羞耻的强烈Fear

target_behavior.consequence: 减少自我暴露与分享,导致Strained intimate relationships;Sleep disturbance,Decreased appetite;授课时注意力受影响
